title: Createful
description: Createful is a survival focused modpack with the Create mod at its core.
body:
Createful, a Minecraft modpack designed for multiplayer survival with a Create mod experience, based off of a modpack made for a few friends.

## Features

- Have endless engineering possibilites with the Create Mod!
- Carry more than ever with Sophisticated Backpacks!
- Use Framed Blocks to level up your builds with new block shapes.
- Build with extensive texture variations using Chipped!
- Use Waystones to travel across the world easily.
- Place tons of blocks in an instant with Construction Wand!
- All this and more is included in **Createful**!

Createful is designed for multiplayer, but works in singleplayer too, This modpack should function on both the server and client.
